AlphaMeaning.description: What the alpha channel of a texture holds.

oneOf.description: Nothing: the channel is fully opaque and is to be ignored.
Smoothness, as in the alpha channel of a `_ddna` normal map.

Basis.description: The axes of every transform and of the GLB meshes.

oneOf.description: glTF's axes, Y up. A reader refuses a basis it does not know.

BuildInfo.description: The Build of the Archive a package was made from, as its build manifest states it.

public_patch.description: The public patch number, when the manifest has one.

ColourSpace.description: How the colour channels of a texture are encoded.

oneOf.description: sRGB transfer curve: colour data, such as a diffuse map.
Linear values: data such as normals, smoothness and metalness.

Coordinates.description: The coordinate system of a package.

basis.description:
The axes: always `gltf_y_up`, glTF's, as the GLB meshes have them. Node transforms are
already converted from the game's Z-up axes by the writer.

Generator.description: The program that wrote a package.

Issue.description: Something that could not be resolved or written.

kind.description: A stable code of the kind, e.g. `geometry_missing` or `texture`.

name.description: The class name of the node's Entity, or the name of the material.

path.description: The port path of the node, or the texture file as the material file names it.

reason.description: The reason in words. Untrusted text from the Archive.

skipped.description: Whether the node is left out of the scene.

Light.description:
A punctual light at a node of the kind `light`.

The node's transform is already turned so that the light shines along its local -Z axis, as
glTF and Blender lights do.

colour.description: The colour in linear red, green and blue, each in 0 to 1.

inner_cone.description:
The angle in radians from the axis where a spot light's falloff begins; present for the
kind `spot`.

intensity.description:
The intensity as the engine states it, not converted to a photometric unit; the engine's
unit is not documented, so the value is only good for comparing lights of one package.

outer_cone.description:
The angle in radians from the axis where a spot light ends, within 0 to a quarter turn;
present for the kind `spot`.

range.description:
The distance in metres beyond which the light has no effect; absent when the light has
none.

oneOf.description: Shines in all directions from the node.
Shines in a cone along the node's -Z axis.
Shines along the node's -Z axis from infinitely far away.

MaterialTextures.description:
The texture ids of a material by role; a role is absent when the material names no texture for
it or the texture could not be written.

Mesh.description: One GLB mesh: the geometry of a model drawn with one material library and one palette.

bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file.description: The GLB file relative to the package folder, e.g. `meshes/m0001.glb`.

geometry.description: The geometry file in the Archive the model was read from, below `Data`.

id.description: The mesh's id, e.g. `m0001`; also the stem of its file.

instances.description: The number of nodes that draw this mesh; more than one means the mesh is instanced.

materials.description: The materials the mesh is drawn with, in the order of the glTF materials in its file.

palette.description: The name of the tint palette the mesh's colours were taken from, when it has one.

triangles.description: The number of triangles of the mesh.

vertices.description: The number of vertices of the mesh.

MeshMaterial.description: A material of a mesh and the textures its material file names.

index.description: The index of the glTF material in the mesh's file.

name.description: The name of the glTF material in the mesh's file.

textures.description: The textures that were written for the material.

Node.description: One node of the scene hierarchy.

entity.description: The Entity placed at the node; present for the kind `entity`, absent for the others.

light.description: The light at the node; present for the kind `light`.

mesh.description: The id of the mesh drawn at the node; absent when the node draws nothing.

name.description:
The node's name: `<port>/<entity>` or the class name for the root, the name from the
Interior's files for the other kinds.

parent.description: The index of the parent node in `nodes`, absent for the root.

path.description:
The path of the node from the root, the port names or, below `Interior`, the names of the
nodes joined by `/`; empty for the root.

rotation.description: The rotation relative to the parent as a unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.

scale.description: The scale relative to the parent; a negative X marks a mirroring transform.

translation.description: The translation relative to the parent, in metres.

oneOf.description: An Entity of the Archive; `entity` names it.

A group of the Interior: the node that holds the containers of an Entity, a container or a
`.soc` file a container streams. It draws nothing.
A model an Interior places, a prop or a placed model; it draws a mesh.
A light an Interior places; `light` describes it.

Options.description: The choices a package was written with.

exclude.description: The ports left out of the Loadout, as the paths `entity loadout` lists.

lod.description:
The level of detail of every model, 0 for the most detailed; a model that lacks it is
written at the nearest lower level.

replace.description: The Entities attached to a port instead of what it holds.

texture_mip.description:
The mip level of the textures, 0 for the largest; a texture with fewer mips gives its
smallest.

vertex_colours.description: Whether the meshes carry the vertex colours of their models.

Replacement.description: An Entity attached to a port instead of what the Loadout puts there.

entity.description: The Entity as the user named it.

build.description: The Build of the Archive; absent when its manifest could not be read.

channel.description:
The Channel folder name of the Archive, e.g. `LIVE`; absent when the Archive is in no
Channel folder.

entity.description: The Entity the scene was built from.

Texture.description: One texture file of the package.

bit_depth.description: The bits per channel; 8 in version 1.

colour_space.description: How the colour channels are encoded.

file.description: The image file relative to the package folder, e.g. `textures/t0001.png`.

height.description: The height in pixels of the mip level that was written.

id.description: The texture's id, e.g. `t0001`; also the stem of its file.

source.description: The texture's path in the Archive, below `Data`.

width.description: The width in pixels of the mip level that was written.

TextureFormat.description: The image format of a texture file.

oneOf.description: Metres. A reader refuses a unit it does not know.

description: The scene description of a package: `scene.json`.

coordinates.description: The axes and unit of every transform and of the GLB meshes.

format.description: Always `p4kx-blender-package`; tells a reader that the folder is a package.

generator.description: The program that wrote the package.

issues.description: What could not be resolved or written, with the node or texture it concerns.

meshes.description: The GLB meshes, one per distinct mesh set; nodes reference them.

nodes.description: The scene hierarchy; a node comes after its parent.

options.description: The choices the package was written with.

textures.description: The PNG textures, each written once.

version.description:
The version of the package format, `<major>.<minor>`, see [`FORMAT_VERSION`]. A reader
refuses a higher major version and warns about a higher minor one.
